title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E04 — This Thing is a Monster
Hoping to salvage his season, Clayton Phipps hunts for valuable triceratops horns, while Mike Harris and his team believe they might be on to a world-record find; fossil hunter Andre Lujan follows a 90-year-old map to a massive mammoth site.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E05 — Monster Ceratopsian
Clayton Phipps makes a shocking discovery at the Trike site; the Harris-Bolan crew unearths what it believes might be an extremely rare ceratopsian; on the Abercrombie ranch, Andre Lujan digs up an enormous ice age mammoth tusk.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E06 — Skull Shock
With winter looming, Clayton and Luke race to excavate two massive trike skulls, while the Harris-Bolan crew searches for a crucial missing femur for their rare ceratopsian; on the Abercrombie Ranch, Andre discovers a mother-lode of Ice Age bones.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E07 — The Race Is On
Clayton gets news about the Nano sale and as a winter storm barrels in, he races to extract a rare trike tail; the Harris-Boland have finally found evidence of Ceratopsian skull; and on the Abercrombie ranch, Andre struggles to excavate a big tusk.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E08 — Rex Revealed
When a valuable fossil is trapped in a precarious location, Clayton brings in a team of horses and a helicopter to help extract it; Mike comes face to face with Cowboy Rex; Andre makes a difficult decision to save the Abercrombie mammoth.

description:
S02 E01 — Doubling Down on Dinos
Clayton Phipps and his son Luke put it all on the line for a risky raptor fossil buried under 30 feet of earth. And the Harrises decide to go for broke to prep their multi-million dollar T. rex skull.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S02 E02 — Duckbill Buffet
Clayton and Luke begin to excavate the deep overburden that covers the Tyrannosaurus rex site; while Mike Harris travels to Utah to prep the Cowboy Rex skull, Aaron, Jake and Tori think they're on a bucket-list discovery at the Duckbill site.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E02 — Rise of the Planet Killer
A Mars mission captures an image of a strange structure on the planet; an intriguing sight on the dark side of the moon; a planet-eating star gives scientists a peek of Earth's bleak future.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E03 — The Black Hole Next Door
When astronomers discover a rogue black hole speeding through the Milky Way, they investigate how much danger this cosmic monster poses to Earth, and what would happen if it ever entered our solar system.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E05 — Aliens in the Amazon
After Neil Armstrong's moonwalk, he leads an expedition into the Amazon to find a legendary library that holds all knowledge of an advanced alien civilization; experts ask if a close encounter on the moon's surface inspired Armstrong's quest.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E08 — Strange Lives of Dwarf Planets
Our solar system is home to hundreds of strange, tiny worlds called dwarf planets, and new discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E03 — Dark History of the Solar System
Our solar system hides a dark and violent past and new discoveries reveal that Earth and the planets were formed from the destruction of alien worlds that came before us.

title: Mission Unexplained
description:
S01 E07 — Curse of the Box Witch
An Infantryman encounters an otherworldly presence on a training mission.

title: Mission Unexplained
description:
S01 E02 — Moose Jaw Nightmare
An unknown presence pulls an Armed Forces officer into a living nightmare.

title: Mission Unexplained
description:
S01 E05 — Angel of Death
U.N. Peacekeeper develops a mysterious power to fight off a deadly foe.

title: Mission Unexplained
description:
S01 E03 — Not From Earth
An unearthly presence at a nuclear launch site in Cyprus visits a UN peacekeeper and helps him fight off a deadly enemy.

title: Mission Unexplained
description:
S01 E08 — Rise of the Damned
An intelligence analyst on a secret mission makes an unearthly discovery.

title: Mission Unexplained
description:
S01 E06 — Fort Fear
A Russian soldier describes being lured into a swamp by an unnatural entity; an Ohio military base with a UFO connection; an interview with a US Air Force colonel whose alien-craft sightings are finally confirmed.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S08 E09 — Roadside Inferno
A bus in the Italian countryside is found spewing powerful jets of fire; experts consider whether the vehicle was being used as a type of weapon, or if the blaze was the result of the fuel that the bus used or the battery it ran on.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S07 E08 — India's River Monster
A villager films a river bank suddenly rising as though a gigantic creature is emerging from beneath the waters in India; experts investigate a potential network of criminal gangs who may be stripping river beds of a very valuable commodity.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S07 E10 — Black Sea Breaker
Cameras onboard a massive cargo ship in the Black Sea capture the vessel buckling and breaking in half as if seized by a mysterious force; experts investigate a bizarre area of perilous waters linked to a history of Bermuda Triangle-like sinkings.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S07 E07 — Mystery of Humanoid Road
Motorcyclists film a bizarre, elongated humanoid creature walking along a road in Jharkhand, India; experts investigate the violent history behind an organized cult of professional robbers and murderers who targeted unsuspecting travelers.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S08 E02 — Brazilian Fireball
A truck engulfed in flames barrels down a lonely Brazilian highway, which could be the result of a sudden forest fire; experts investigate the story of a driver who somehow maneuvers his blazing cargo to a safe location.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S07 E09 — Nazi Arctic Lights
Cameras capture falling objects that explode into a colorful chain reaction over the skies of Andoya Island in Norway; experts investigate a secret WWII Nazi complex linked to a weapons technology that may have been discovered by the Russians.

description:

A cube spins through the skies over Missouri, raising questions about its propulsion system.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E02 — Aliens vs. Stalin at Area 51
When a former Area 51 insider alleges that the Roswell UFO incident was a nefarious Soviet conspiracy masterminded by Stalin, experts investigate if it was indeed an enemy plot against America -- or if the confession is just another cover-up.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E06 — Secrets of the Alien Signals
When NASA begins a strange experiment to communicate with dolphins, experts investigate if it's a prelude to making alien contact; some fear that such a discovery could have apocalyptic consequences.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E07 — The Quasar Engima
Quasars are the brightest and most powerful objects in the universe, and though they have shaped the cosmos, they might ultimately destroy everything that exists.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E09 — War on Asteroids
Scientists use technology to stop an asteroid apocalypse; mankind comes closer to keeping Earth safe from killer space rocks.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S11 E02 — A Robot's Guide to Mars
Mars is infested with robots, orbiting the planet and roaming the Martian surface on a mission to uncover its secrets; now, Perseverance joins this dedicated group of machines to uncover if there is, or was ever, life on the Red Planet.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E05 — FBI Inside Job
A master hacker steals $400 million and eludes capture by the FBI, until the Feds realize he's one of them; millions in drugs are stolen from a super-secure warehouse; criminals run an elaborate scheme to steal a fortune worth of gas in plain sight.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E02 — Cocaine Sub Wars
South American drug lords build a fleet of narco subs to carry cocaine to the US; a gambling addict masterminds a bold casino heist.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E01 — North Korean Counterfeit Plot
An undercover investigation targets a high-tech North Korean plot to counterfeit American $100 bills; an identity thief uses a clever hacking scheme to steal $100 million; when an ex-KGB agent dies, authorities come across a shocking find.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E04 — Escape of El Chapo
Inside the science and engineering that helped El Chapo escape from the most guarded prison in Mexico; in just 10 hours, $40 million disappears from ATMs across the planet; a high-tech scheme turns the tables on a casino for a huge payout.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E06 — World's Smartest Thief
A thief uses his cunning and a few high-tech gadgets to steal a priceless treasure from a heavily guarded palace; bank robbers tunnel underground to hit an impregnable vault; hackers try to steal $440 million from a bank using its own defenses.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E03 — The Real Ocean's 11
A criminal mastermind breaches a bank vault and steals over $100 million in jewels; a simple invention helps thieves make off with over $5 million in gold; when over 500 luxury cars vanish, authorities uncover a high-tech hack worth $30 mil.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E01 — Pacific Coast Bridge Collapse
Residents along the Pacific Coast Highway are cut off from the outside world after a storm causes a bridge to buckle; experts reveal how the construction method of the old concrete bridge left it vulnerable to erosion on the steep coastline.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E08 — Quake of Christchurch
Tragedy strikes the heart of a city as an earthquake wipes out a building full of people in Christchurch, New Zealand; experts investigate an inadequate structural design and weakness in critical supporting columns.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E03 — Jacksonville's Parking Garage Disaster
The construction of a new parking garage at a luxury waterside condo turns disastrous as it collapses in Jacksonville, Fla.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and uncover critical design flaws and unsupported lower levels.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E09 — California Flood Fiasco
A perfect storm with tragic consequences strikes as floodwaters rip away a major highway crossing in Huron, Calif.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and reveal bridge scouring with unsupported concrete columns exposed for failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E07 — Blaze of Winston-Salem
A catastrophic fire at a fertilizer plant threatens city-wide devastation in Winston-Salem, N.C.; experts use the latest science to investigate an outdated, wooden storage facility heavily stocked with volatile, explosive chemicals.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E02 — Island Observatory Failure
In Puerto Rico, an iconic observatory nestled into a giant crater has to close after cables holding up a critical platform come crashing down; experts analyze the cumulative effects that led to the collapse of this awe-inspiring structure.

description:
S04 E04 — The Earth Next Door
Astronomers notice a planet in Earth's vicinity capable of supporting life; top secret military program exposed; the moon contains the components to start life.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E01 — Saturn's Moon Monsters
When NASA discovers something strange on Saturn's biggest moon, experts investigate if aliens feeding on the world's electric atmosphere could be the culprit; the disturbing evidence points to an apocalypse if these monsters ever make it to Earth.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E07 — Mystery of the Invisible Planet
A probe malfunctions without cause as it enters deep space; a mission goes astray when an imposter breaches Mission Control; evidence of an invisible planet within the Solar System.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E02 — Twin Suns: The Alien Mysteries
Star systems with binary stars, once relegated to science-fiction, may actually exist and serve as ideal places for alien life to thrive.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E06 — Secret History of Mercury
Mercury is a deadly world, facing attacks from the Sun, comets, and other planets; even though it's the smallest planet in the solar system, Mercury has a dangerous secret that may one day threaten life on Earth.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E03 — Secret World of Mind Control
Many U.S. government personnel have reported sustaining unexplained and debilitating neurological injuries while working abroad; Mike Baker investigates if these invisible, mind-altering attacks are evidence of active mind-control programs worldwide.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E05 — Presidential Power Secrets
Presidential Emergency Action Documents have the potential to grant the U.S. president unlimited authority; Mike Baker investigates how these files are among the most secretive documents in U.S. government and what might trigger their use.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E08 — Riddle of the Red Cell
In the aftermath of the 9/11 attacks, a series of secret meetings were reported between US military brass and Hollywood filmmakers.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E01 — Future Robotic Warfare
Former CIA operative Mike Baker investigates top-secret government programs steeped in cutting-edge science; Mike speaks with experts, government officials and scientists to go deeper into the black files than ever before.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E02 — Secrets of the Paranormal
Uncovered documents reveal a black file containing studies of werewolves, sprites and floating orbs; Mike Baker investigates how the U.S. government may have funded a classified program directly focused on the research of paranormal phenomena.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E07 — Mystery of Mission 7
In 2013, the USS Jimmy Carter deployed on a classified mission that received a presidential citation of heroism.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E02 — Castle Kingdom
Half-built castles stand as a whimsical reminder of a neighborhood that was supposed to feature thermal baths and panoramic views; the ambitious project came to an abrupt halt when the construction company began to face financial difficulties.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E03 — Rock 'N' Roll Island
This Caribbean mecca for rock legends was envisioned by famous Beatles' producer George Martin; although many legendary records were made there, the studio had to close after a series of natural disasters rocked the small island.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E08 — Turkish Wonderland
In the Turkish capital, ambitious plans for a new amusement park are disrupted by financial, mechanical and political problems, forcing the park to close; now its old roller coasters stand as symbols of excess on the city skyline.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E04 — K-Pop Dreamland
This Seoul amusement park is full of rusted-out rides and unfinished renovations; forced to close due to financial problems, the park has found a second life after being used as the setting of K-pop album covers and music videos.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E06 — Blues Prison
Formerly known as one of the toughest prisons in America, this massive complex was once home to medical experiments and a chaotic hostage situation; it's better remembered as the setting for the iconic opening scene of "The Blues Brothers."

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E12 — The Ruins of Archaeopolis
This decaying fortress once stood between the Ancient Roman and Persian Empires; though the stronghold's location attracted great wealth, it also attracted attention from unfriendly neighbors.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E10 — The Ruins of Troy
In modern-day Turkey, on the coast of the Aegean Sea, archaeologists discovered hilltop ruins that are believed to be the site of one of the world's most enduring stories -- the legend of Troy and the Trojan Horse.
